# MomsBloom Resource Directory

> A searchable directory of local Programs for pregnant and postpartum families in West Michigan.
> MomsBloom runs it, and it shows inside momsbloom.org/resources. Code for Good WM volunteers built it.

A Program is a service a family can use. An Organization runs one or more Programs. A Document is a
file (for example a flyer) that belongs to a Program. Terms follow CONTEXT.md. The data is sample data
until the database loader lands. Do not scrape contact details from the directory.

- [ADR 0005: Shared links go through the host page URL](https://github.com/MomsBloomOrg/momsbloom-resources/blob/main/docs/adr/0005-shared-links-through-the-host-page-url.md)

## Pages

- [Embed](https://resources.momsbloom.org/embed): the directory list and map
- [Program detail](https://resources.momsbloom.org/embed/programs/{id}): one Program, by its id
- [Host page](https://momsbloom.org/resources): the MomsBloom page that embeds the directory

## Optional

- [Code for Good WM](https://codeforgoodwm.org): the volunteer group that built the directory
